steps.name: environment - verify psql/pg_isready and create safe profile defaults (no secrets by default)
steps.description: Verify psql and pg_isready exist (fail fast if missing). Create an atomic /etc/profile.d/price_comp_dev.sh containing non-secret defaults (POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_DB, PGHOST, PGPORT, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY). Do NOT persist POSTGRES_PASSWORD unless PROFILE_PERSIST_SECRETS=1 is explicitly set. Write PATH lines using an escaped $PATH to avoid baking the current PATH. Set file permissions before sourcing to avoid exposing secrets to the current shell if opt-in used.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/price-comparison-hub-327751/database_postgresql"
PROFILE_FILE="/etc/profile.d/price_comp_dev.sh"
# Verify required binaries are present (psql and pg_isready). Fail with clear code if missing.
if ! command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "psql not found (postgresql-client missing)" >&2; exit 10
fi
if ! command -v pg_isready >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "pg_isready not found (postgresql-client missing)" >&2; exit 11
fi
# Prepare atomic profile content (non-secret defaults only)
TMP="$(mktemp)"
cat > "$TMP" <<'EOF'
# Price-comparison dev defaults (dev-only). To persist secrets set PROFILE_PERSIST_SECRETS=1 before running this script.
export POSTGRES_USER="postgres"
export POSTGRES_DB="dev_db"
export PGHOST="${PGHOST:-localhost}"
export PGPORT="${PGPORT:-5432}"
export SUPABASE_URL="http://localhost:54321"
export SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="dev-anon-key"
# Ensure local node_modules bin is searched at login (do not bake current $PATH)
export PATH="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/price-comparison-hub-327751/database_postgresql/node_modules/.bin:\$PATH"
EOF
# If opt-in to persist secrets, append password with restricted perms
if [ "${PROFILE_PERSIST_SECRETS:-0}" = "1" ] && [ -n "${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then
  echo "export POSTGRES_PASSWORD=\"$POSTGRES_PASSWORD\"" >> "$TMP"
  sudo mv "$TMP" "$PROFILE_FILE"
  sudo chmod 600 "$PROFILE_FILE"
else
  sudo mv "$TMP" "$PROFILE_FILE"
  sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE_FILE"
fi
# Source only after permissions are set
if [ -f "$PROFILE_FILE" ]; then
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source "$PROFILE_FILE"
fi

steps.name: dependencies - install @supabase/cli locally and verify node/npm compatibility
steps.description: Ensure workspace has a package.json, verify node and npm versions are present and within reasonable bounds (node>=18, npm>=9 if available), install @supabase/cli locally only if 'supabase' is not already available on PATH, append an idempotent PATH line to /etc/profile.d using escaped $PATH, set perms, then source the profile so supabase is immediately available in the current shell. Fail fast on npm install errors.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/price-comparison-hub-327751/database_postgresql"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Ensure package.json exists
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ]; then
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/package.json" <<'JSON'
{ "name":"db-dev", "private":true }
JSON
fi
# Check node/npm versions (best-effort; fail if missing)
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "node or npm missing from image" >&2; exit 12
fi
NODE_VER=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo "")
NPM_VER=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo "")
# Optional: warn if versions are very old (non-fatal)
# Install @supabase/cli locally only if no global supabase present
if ! command -v supabase >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent @supabase/cli@latest || { echo "npm install @supabase/cli failed" >&2; exit 13; }
  PROFILE_FILE="/etc/profile.d/price_comp_dev.sh"
  # Idempotent exact-path line to avoid duplicates
  PATH_LINE="export PATH=\"$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin:\$PATH\""
  if [ -f "$PROFILE_FILE" ]; then
    if ! grep -Fxq "$PATH_LINE" "$PROFILE_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
      sudo sh -c "printf '\n# include local node bin\n$PATH_LINE\n' >> $PROFILE_FILE"
      sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE_FILE"
    fi
  else
    sudo sh -c "printf '%s\n' '# include local node bin' '$PATH_LINE' > $PROFILE_FILE"
    sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE_FILE"
  fi
  # Source the profile now (permissions already set)
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source "$PROFILE_FILE"
fi
# Verify supabase is runnable
if command -v supabase >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  supabase --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

steps.name: scaffolding - create migrations, idempotent schema/seed, and run_migrations helper
steps.description: Create migrations directory with idempotent schema.sql and seed.sql for price_history. Generate a robust run_migrations.sh helper that waits for DB readiness with exponential backoff, sanitizes psql outputs, checks psql exit codes, creates the database if missing, and applies migrations with ON_ERROR_STOP. Document that POSTGRES_USER must have DB creation privileges or run as superuser; only attempt role creation when connected as a superuser.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/price-comparison-hub-327751/database_postgresql"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/migrations" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
# schema.sql (idempotent)
cat > "$WORKSPACE/migrations/schema.sql" <<'SQL'
BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS price_history (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  price NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  recorded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now()
);
COMMIT;
SQL
# seed.sql idempotent
cat > "$WORKSPACE/migrations/seed.sql" <<'SQL'
INSERT INTO price_history (product_id, price, currency) VALUES
('sku-001', 19.99, 'USD'),
('sku-002', 5.49, 'USD')
ON CONFLICT (product_id) DO NOTHING;
SQL
# run_migrations.sh helper (robust checks)
cat > "$WORKSPACE/run_migrations.sh" <<'BASH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/price-comparison-hub-327751/database_postgresql"
[ -f /etc/profile.d/price_comp_dev.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/price_comp_dev.sh
PGHOST="${PGHOST:-localhost}"; PGPORT="${PGPORT:-5432}"; PGUSER="${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}"; PGDB="${POSTGRES_DB:-dev_db}"
RETRIES=6; SLEEP=1
for i in $(seq 1 $RETRIES); do
  if pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    break
  fi
  sleep $((SLEEP * i))
done
pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "postgres not ready on $PGHOST:$PGPORT" >&2; exit 2; }
# Check DB existence safely
COUNT_RAW=$(PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d postgres -t -A -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '$PGDB';")
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "psql query failed checking database existence" >&2; exit 3; fi
COUNT=$(printf '%s' "$COUNT_RAW" | tr -d '[:space:]')
if [ -z "$COUNT" ]; then COUNT=0; fi
if [ "$COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
  # Attempt to create DB. This requires that PGUSER has CREATE DATABASE privilege or is a superuser.
  PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE DATABASE \"$PGDB\";" || { echo "failed to create database $PGDB (ensure $PGUSER has CREATE DATABASE privilege)" >&2; exit 4; }
fi
# Apply migrations
PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d "$PGDB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$WORKSPACE/migrations/schema.sql"
PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d "$PGDB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$WORKSPACE/migrations/seed.sql"
BASH
chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/run_migrations.sh"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Scaffold migrations and a robust run_migrations helper for price_history
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/price-comparison-hub-327751/database_postgresql"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/migrations" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
# schema.sql (idempotent)
cat > "$WORKSPACE/migrations/schema.sql" <<'SQL'
BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS price_history (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  price NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  recorded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now()
);
COMMIT;
SQL
# seed.sql (idempotent)
cat > "$WORKSPACE/migrations/seed.sql" <<'SQL'
INSERT INTO price_history (product_id, price, currency) VALUES
('sku-001', 19.99, 'USD'),
('sku-002', 5.49, 'USD')
ON CONFLICT (product_id) DO NOTHING;
SQL
# run_migrations.sh helper (robust checks, idempotent)
cat > "$WORKSPACE/run_migrations.sh" <<'BASH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Robust migration runner:
# - Waits for Postgres readiness with exponential backoff
# - Checks psql exit codes and sanitizes outputs
# - Creates database if missing (requires POSTGRES_USER to have CREATE DATABASE or be superuser)
# - Applies migrations with ON_ERROR_STOP
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/price-comparison-hub-327751/database_postgresql"
[ -f /etc/profile.d/price_comp_dev.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/price_comp_dev.sh
PGHOST="${PGHOST:-localhost}"; PGPORT="${PGPORT:-5432}"; PGUSER="${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}"; PGDB="${POSTGRES_DB:-dev_db}"
# Wait for postgres readiness with exponential backoff
MAX_RETRIES=6; BASE_SLEEP=1
i=0
until pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
  i=$((i+1))
  if [ "$i" -ge "$MAX_RETRIES" ]; then
    echo "postgres not ready on $PGHOST:$PGPORT after $i attempts" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  sleep $((BASE_SLEEP * i))
done
# Helper to run psql and capture output and exit code
run_psql() {
  local db="$1"; shift
  # Keep PGPASSWORD optional; do not persist secret here
  PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d "$db" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 "$@"
}
# Check database existence
COUNT_RAW=$(PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d postgres -t -A -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '$PGDB';" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "${COUNT_RAW:-}" ]; then
  # If empty, treat as 0 (but ensure we surfaced psql failure earlier)
  COUNT=0
else
  COUNT=$(printf '%s' "$COUNT_RAW" | tr -d '[:space:]')
fi
if [ -z "$COUNT" ]; then COUNT=0; fi
if [ "$COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
  # Attempt to create DB. This requires that PGUSER has CREATE DATABASE privilege or is superuser.
  if ! PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE DATABASE \"$PGDB\";" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "failed to create database $PGDB (ensure $PGUSER has CREATE DATABASE privilege or run as superuser)" >&2
    exit 4
  fi
fi
# Apply schema then seed with ON_ERROR_STOP
if ! PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d "$PGDB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$WORKSPACE/migrations/schema.sql"; then
  echo "applying schema failed" >&2
  exit 5
fi
if ! PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}" psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d "$PGDB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$WORKSPACE/migrations/seed.sql"; then
  echo "applying seed failed" >&2
  exit 6
fi
echo "migrations applied to $PGDB@${PGHOST}:${PGPORT}"
BASH
chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/run_migrations.sh"

# Ensure migrations and helper exist and are executable
ls -l "$WORKSPACE/migrations" || true
ls -l "$WORKSPACE/run_migrations.sh" || true
